text:
Maria: Heads-up: planning v2 soft launch next Tue. main focus: routing by API-key tag + console opt-in. Thoughts?
Kevin: Sounds good. Do we have telemetry to detect v1 traffic using features v2 will break? e.g., function_call presence, streaming semantics changes.
Raj: We can add a "compatibility_signal" that looks for `X-Client-Features` and presence of `function_call` in requests. Router already logs feature flags, need a dashboard to surface.
Amy: Console UX idea: per-org banner 'Try v2 (preview)' + per-api-key toggle in keys page. Must show projected billing delta and an easy rollback button.
Maria: Agree. Also need quota mapping rules: v2 token accounting will change due to newline normalization + model tokenizer tweaks. Ops, can you confirm billing impact?
Oliver: Quick estimate: ~1-2% token delta typical, some customers ~10-20% on edge cases. Recommend console show a projected delta before flip and an optional simulate run.
Kevin: Can router do per-key split (e.g. 5% -> v2, 95% -> v1)? And failover to v1 if v2 has 5xx or latency spike?
Raj: Yes. We already support split routing and failover. Example policy we can wire into runtime:
```json
{
  "route_policy": {
    "split": 0.05,
    "failover_on": "latency_ms>500 || status>=500",
    "fallback_route": "v1"
  }
}
```
Maria: Great. Dashboard needs: per-api_key split % (actual), percent errors, median latency, token delta, and 'feature-mismatch' event counts. Who owns the dashboard?
SRE-Bot: Incident runbook: https://wiki/redwood/runbooks/v2-rollout. Use `@oncall` for alerts; suggested thresholds included.
Raj: I'll own initial dashboards + alert defs. Will push grafana panels and a console widget to show the 30-day projection.
Amy: UX copy draft: 'Try v2: faster inference, potential billing delta. Rollback anytime with one click.' Thoughts?
Kevin: Add a checkbox 'Simulate billing impact (last 30 days)' that runs the projection for the org. Also show a list of keys that will be part of the split.
Oliver: :thumbsup: SGTM. Also add a compatibility warning for clients using features that differ in v2 (function_call schema, tab/whitespace tokenization) and list example affected clients.
Maria: Action items: Raj -> dashboard + routing flag config; Kevin -> runtime fallback tests; Amy -> console mockups + copy; Oliver -> quota delta calc + legal loop-in. Due EOD Fri. Any objections?
Kevin: No objections. I'll add an integration test that flips a flag for one key and asserts fallback happens within 2s and no dropped requests.
Raj: I'll post PR with dashboard json, route policy config, and a stubbed console endpoint for projections. Will ping @Maria when ready.
Maria: Thanks. Also flagging Legal for billing language. @Oliver can you loop them in?
Oliver: Will do, pinging legal now.
Deploy-Bot: deploy v2-rollout-feature-flag to staging succeeded — 12 nodes, CI: all green.
Maria: Perfect, thanks everyone. We'll sync in the rollout sync tomorrow at 10am.
